thesis: SEZL is a high-quality, fast-growing, highly profitable lender whose post-earnings gap has been digested in a 145-158 range above rising 20/50/200-day averages. A pullback entry in 149-154 with a stop at 144.5 offers about 3.5 reward/risk toward the 178.55 gap high, with the 52-week high as the extension. Fundamentals are strong with low dilution risk, and no offering or scheduled event is visible in the window. The setup is only moderate. The risk-off regime, a sold-into gap, very high beta and mixed BNPL peer news argue for small size and a strict stop.
